title: Inverted error handling logic
detail: The new condition inverts the original logic: it clears the error when `should_ignore_error` is not set or returns False, instead of only when it returns True. This causes all errors to be swallowed unless the deprecated method is explicitly defined and returns True, breaking normal error propagation.
note: Says the condition is inverted, so errors are cleared when they shouldn't be, which the planted `not` does.

title: Incorrect dunder method check in ChainableUndefined
detail: The condition incorrectly raises AttributeError for attribute names that are not dunder methods but end with "__", breaking normal attribute access and causing failures in protocols like copy and pickle.
note: Says names that only end in `__` raise, which the planted `!=` does.

title: TypeError due to None comparison
detail: When max_digits is None, the condition still compares max_digits <= decimal_places, causing a TypeError because None cannot be compared to int.
note: Names the comparison of a None `max_digits` with `<=`.

title: Incorrect __Host- validation logic
detail: The function returns False for any cookie whose name starts with "__host-" because the first part of the return expression is `not name.startswith("__host-")`, which is False for such cookies. This means all __Host- cookies are rejected regardless of whether they meet the required conditions (secure, https, domain not specified, path "/").
note: Says `__Host-` cookies are always rejected, which the planted `and` does.
